usageNote: 动词短语！说去某地冒险专用，underground加了神秘感，适合讲故事或聊旅行，听起来超酷！

examples.en: We decided to go on an exciting adventure underground in the ancient cave system.
examples.zh: 我们决定去古老的洞穴系统里进行一次令人兴奋的地下探险。

examples.en: The kids were thrilled to go on an exciting adventure underground during the field trip.
examples.zh: 孩子们在这次实地考察中能去地下探险，兴奋极了。
